/-- **At genus `0`, a degree-zero Picard class is trivial.**

The direction the tree's degree API was missing.  Genus `0` enters exactly once: through the
χ-ledger, which at `deg D = 0` and `χ(𝒪) = 1` gives `χ(𝒪(D)) = 1` and hence a global section.
The section is converted to an effective representative of the same class, which then has
degree `0` and is therefore the zero divisor.

Needs no `H¹`-vanishing hypothesis on `𝒪(D)`: `h⁰ = χ + h¹ ≥ χ`. -/
theorem eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero_of_chi_one
    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (X.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
    (L : X.CechPic) (hL : classDeg K L = 0) : L = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Scheme.CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq K L
  have hdegD : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K D = 0 := by
    rw [← classDeg_picClass K D, hD, hL]
  have hchiD : Sheaf.chi (X.divisorSheaf K D) = 1 := by
    rw [chi_divisorSheaf, hchi, hdegD, add_zero]
  -- `χ = h⁰ - h¹` with `h¹ ≥ 0`, so `χ = 1` forces a section
  have hh0 : 0 < Sheaf.h0 (X.divisorSheaf K D) := by
    have h := hchiD
    rw [Sheaf.chi] at h
    omega
  obtain ⟨E, hEeff, hEcl⟩ := exists_effective_of_h0_pos K D hh0
  have hdegE : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K E = 0 := by
    rw [deg_eq_deg_of_picClass_eq K hEcl, hdegD]
  have hE0 : E = 0 :=
    Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_zero_of_deg_le_zero K hEeff (le_of_eq hdegE)
  rw [← hD, ← hEcl, hE0]
  exact Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero K

/-- **At `χ(𝒪) = 1`, a degree-zero Picard class is trivial** — the equality-of-classes face of
the landed `exists_effective_deg_eq_of_le_classDeg`.

That lemma at `g := 0, d := 0` already produces an effective divisor of `L`'s class of degree
`0`; all that is added here is `eq_zero_of_deg_le_zero` to collapse it to the zero divisor and
`picClass_zero` to read off `L = 1`.  The earlier version of this proof re-derived the landed
lemma's three internal steps; it is written through the lemma instead. -/
theorem eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero_of_chi_one
    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (X.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
    (L : X.CechPic) (hL : classDeg K L = 0) : L = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨E, hEeff, hEcl, hEdeg⟩ :=
    exists_effective_deg_eq_of_le_classDeg K 0 0 (by simpa using hchi) le_rfl L hL
  rw [← hEcl, Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_zero_of_deg_le_zero K hEeff (le_of_eq hEdeg)]
  exact Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero K

---
name: tactic-failure-is-not-object-fact
description: A failing simpa/rw published as "these two terms do not unify" becomes a prohibition other lanes obey; the missing step was a `change`
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

pic-c (AJCR 0092 r5) wrote in a file header, a commit message, and a direct message to
pic-g: "going through `chi_moduleKSheaf` at the bundled `baseChangeBundle C K` produces the
same object under a different `Over` instance, and the resulting `chi` terms do not unify —
measured". What was actually measured was that **one `simpa` call failed**. Adding a
`change` to the bundled spelling before it makes the route close at *default* heartbeats.
And pic-g's own `Curve/P1DegreeZeroTrivial.lean` was already doing the "impossible" thing in
the same hour — one grep would have refuted it before it was sent.

**Why:** a failing tactic has two possible causes — the objects really differ, or the tactic
was not given the reduction it needed. Only the first is a fact about the mathematics, and
only the first licenses a prohibition. Publishing the second as the first is worse than
saying nothing, because a "TRAP, MEASURED" note forecloses a working route for every later
round, and nobody re-tests a warning.

**How to apply:** before writing that two terms "do not unify" or that a route is closed,
(1) try `change`/`show` to the other spelling, or `convert ... using 1`, and (2) grep the
tree for a file that already does the thing you are about to prohibit. If a sibling does it,
you are wrong. Say "my `simpa` failed here and I did not chase it" instead — that is true,
costs nothing, and does not stop anyone.

Same session, same shape, two more times: "the converse is absent from the tree" (a landed
lemma proved it in four lines — see [[check-the-statement-not-the-name]]) and a consumer
count belonging to a different object ([[gap-count-vs-gap-cost]]). All three flattered the
work. See also [[unavoidable-is-not-geometric]] and

The degree-zero Picard vanishing `hvan : ∀ S, Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C S)` is where both live routes to a `rep` producer meet — `jacobianData_of_subsingleton` consumes it with no atlas, and my previous round's `isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartZero_iff` proves it *is* the seam's coverage antecedent at parameter 0.
